svg.title: The private-computation boundary
svg.desc: Plaintext stays at the app/client edge. Shares enter the boundary. Only explicit outputs leave.
svg.text: Sensitive context becomes ordinary application state.
Sensitive context crosses the boundary only as shares.

text.style: font-family: DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; text-anchor: middle; opacity:.84;
